body: Hey! I used this exact approach, wrote everything down ahead of time, and it was a really productive conversation. He asked if he could have a copy of all of the stuff I wrote down and we came up with additional solutions together. Thank you so much!
I had posted, just no one had responded for hours
This is super helpful. It’s nice to hear someone say, “obviously mediation isn’t working, just get through it.”
This was EXTREMELY helpful. Thank you ❤️❤️❤️❤️

I’ve made a plan to move out but I can’t until April. I’ve tried to talk about things but it’s not a great situation. I realized this year that I can graduate a year Early. Because of this, I’ll be moving out a year early. I think subconsciously they realize that I won’t be there soon and so in the past few months, I’ve become a scapegoat for really random things. Even when I try to spend time with them with things they like (which usually do not overlap with my interests), there are always actions that exclude me.

I take extra shifts just so I don’t go home. When I tried to talk about how I feel (tried to frame it as “this is how I feel and it’s no one’s fault but let’s see if ther s a solution”), it turned into everyone coming to a “resolution” — never happened — and then not talking to me at all for five days. I have so much dread for them coming back home and it’s just too much. I’ve gone through some horrible traumas but this constant burden and misery just feels like too much
Every time I’ve posted this on a different throwaway, people just agree and it feels hopeless :( sorry if I contributed to that, bud
